item.title: JurassicFi Plans Tokenized Dinosaur Fossil Offering on Solana Network
item.summary: JurassicFi plans to tokenize a museum-grade Triceratops skull on Solana via an SPV-backed SPL token targeting a 660,000 USDC raise, but key claims — including a reported $5.5M fundraise and a $50M T-Rex auction sale — remain unverified with no on-chain minting confirmed as of August 9, 2026.
